answer: No onyx badge is issued until an applicant presents three quill receipts from three unrelated payers for three jobs done in the last 90 days. The registry rejects any reused receipt, checks that the payers share no funder or wallet cluster, and runs sparrow audits that re-contact a random 10% of payers to confirm the work. A failed or reused receipt voids the application and forfeits the fee. Forging 1,000 sybils therefore needs 3,000 distinct payer relationships and $60,000 in fees with no bulk discount, while an honest user with real work pays $60 once.
